CLI-12.label: P
CLI-12.reason: This is in the same command-line parsing subsystem and involves how `PosixParser` assigns tokens to option values versus treating them as extra args. The mechanism is related—token classification and handling of values that look like options—but the specific failure here is about a `-D` option consuming trailing arguments, not a quoted/negative-looking parameter being misread as a new option.

CLI-104.label: R
CLI-104.reason: This report directly matches the current failure pattern: allowing a hyphen-prefixed value as an option argument, e.g. `-Dnumber=-1` and “allow - in second argument.” The bug report and test both concern `PosixParser` misinterpreting a parameter value beginning with `-` as a new option, so this is highly likely to point to the same parsing logic and fix area.
